# apple_ci_xcode_versions (Data Source)

Lists the Xcode versions Xcode Cloud offers, with the macOS versions that run each and the destinations it tests on.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_ci_xcode_versions" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `xcode_versions` (Attributes List) The Xcode versions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--xcode_versions))

<a id="nestedatt--xcode_versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `xcode_versions`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Xcode version.
- `mac_os_version_ids` (List of String) App Store Connect IDs of the macOS versions that run this Xcode version.
- `name` (String) Name, e.g. `Xcode 26`.
- `test_destinations` (Attributes List) Simulators and Macs a test action can run on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--xcode_versions--test_destinations))
- `version` (String) Version, e.g. `26.0`.

<a id="nestedatt--xcode_versions--test_destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `xcode_versions.test_destinations`

Read-Only:

- `available_runtimes` (Attributes List) Runtimes the device type runs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--xcode_versions--test_destinations--available_runtimes))
- `device_type_identifier` (String) Identifier of the device type.
- `device_type_name` (String) Name of the device type.
- `kind` (String) Kind of destination: `SIMULATOR` or `MAC`.

<a id="nestedatt--xcode_versions--test_destinations--available_runtimes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `xcode_versions.test_destinations.available_runtimes`

Read-Only:

- `runtime_identifier` (String) Identifier of the runtime.
- `runtime_name` (String) Name of the runtime.
